company.shortDescription: Govini is a software company that transforms defense acquisition and national-security decision-making through data, analytics, and AI.
company.description: Govini is a software company that transforms defense acquisition and national-security decision-making through data, analytics, and AI. The company's flagship product, Ark, is a suite of AI-enabled applications built on a proprietary “National Security Knowledge Graph” that integrates commercial and government data to support workflows across supply chain, science & technology, production, sustainment, logistics, and modernization. Govini serves the U.S. Department of Defense, military services, national-security agencies, and contractors, helping users replace manual acquisition and procurement processes with accelerated, software-driven decision tools.

productsAndServices.description: A software platform that integrates commercial and government data to support decision-making across Defense Acquisition domains such as supply chain, science and technology, production, sustainment, and modernization.
